items.title: SK Hynix’s Solidigm Weighs IPO That Could Raise $15 Billion, Report Says
items.summary: The IPO could raise about $15 billion and value Solidigm at as much as $150 billion, the report said.  “Solidigm is reviewing various options to strengthen its business competitiveness, but no specific plans have been confirmed at this time,” an SK Hynix spokesperson said in a statement.  The potential IPO would mark a deeper push into the U.S. public market for SK Hynix, which is the world’s leading memory chip maker by revenue.

items.title: Our Pick Of The Best Growth Stocks In September 2026
items.summary: Bond markets have been shaken by 10-year Treasury yields hitting a 19-year high, which raises borrowing costs and forces investors to rethink where future returns might come from. That kind of reset often shifts attention toward businesses where earnings are expected to grow solidly and balance sheets still look healthy. This article highlights three stocks that fit that profile and explains how they may fit into a long-term growth plan. The three stocks covered next are only a small sample...

items.title: AI Trade Picks Up Again as Investors Pile Back Into Stocks
items.summary: The artificial-intelligence rally looked set to restart on Friday, as a drop in bond yields gave risk assets a boost. Glassmaker Corning, optical networking companies Coherent and Lumentum, server maker Dell, and flash-memory product supplier Sandisk were all rallying ahead of the opening bell.
